payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort magnet centers by x and y. Enumerate all ways to remove up to k magnets from the left, right, bottom, and top extremes. For each valid combination, compute bounding rectangle area and keep minimum.
payload.rationale: The solution uses nested loops to try every possible count of removed magnets from each extreme direction, limited by k. This is an exhaustive search over a small (O(k^4)) space, not a greedy approach.
